G3423.def:
**μνηστεύω **
[in LXX for אָרַשׂ pi., pu. ;]
1. to woo and win, espouse.
2. **to promise in marriage, betroth**; pass., of the woman, **to be be­trothed**: with dative of person(s), [[Mat.1.18|Mat.1:18]], [[Luk.1.27; 2.5|Luk.1:27 2:5]].†
(AS)

G3478.def:
**Ναζαρά**
([[Mat.4.13|Mat.4:13]]­ L, -άθ­[[Luk.4.16|Luk.4:16]])
Ναζαρέθ ([[Mat.21.11|Mat.21:11]], [[Act.10.38|Act.10:38]]),
Ναζαρέτ (so always Rec.; WH, in foll, instances, where -έθ, T), ἡ,
indecl. (Semitic form uncertain),
**Nazareth**: [[Mat.2.23|Mat.2:23]], [[Mrk.1.9|Mrk.1:9]], [[Luk.1.26; 2.4, 39; 2.51|Luk.1:26 2:4, 39 2:51]], [[Jhn.1.45-46|Jhn.1:45-46]].†
(AS)

G3471.def:
**μωραίνω**
(μωρός), [in LXX: [[Isa.19.11|Isa.19:11]], [[Jer.10.14; 51.17|Jer.10:14 51:17]] (בָּעַר ni.), [[2Ki.24.10|2Ki.24:10]], [[Isa.44.25|Isa.44:25]] R (שָׂכַל ni., pi.)* ;]
1. cl., to be foolish, play the fool.
2. **LXX and NT, causal, to make foolish**: [[1Co.1.20|1Co.1:20]] pass., **to become foolish**: [[Rom.1.22|Rom.1:22]] of salt that has lost its flavour, **become tasteless**: [[Mat.5.13|Mat.5:13]], [[Luk.14.34|Luk.14:34]].†
(AS)

G3426.def:
**μοιχαλίς**, -ίδος, ἡ
(= Att.. μοιχάς, fem. of μοιχός), [in LXX: [[Pro.18.22|Pro.18:22]] 30:20), [[Ezk.16.38; 23.45|Eze.16:38 23:45]], [[Hos.3.1|Hos.3:1]], [[Mal.3.5|Mal.3:5]] (נַאֲפוּף, נָאַף) * ;]
**an adulteress**: [[Rom.7.3|Rom.7:3]] meton., for μοιχεία, [[2Pe.2.14|2Pe.2:14]] Metaphorical, of infidelity to God (cf. [[Ezk.16.15|Eze.16:15]] ff. [[Ezk.23.43|Eze.23:43]] ff., al.), [[Jas.4.4|Jas.4:4]]; as an adj., [[Mat.12.39; 16.4|Mat.12:39 16:4]], [[Mrk.8.8|Mrk.8:8]].†
(AS)

G3474.def:
**μωρός**, -ά, -όν
[in LXX for נָבָל, etc.; frequently in Sir. ;]
1. prop., of the nerves, dull, sluggish (Hipp., Arist.).
2. **Of the mind, dull, stupid, foolish**: [[Mat.5.22|Mat.5:22]] (see Field, _Notes_, 3 ff.) [[Mat.7.26; 23.17, 19|Mat.7:26 23:17, 19]] (T, WH, txt., R, om.) [[Mat.25.2-3|Mat.25:2-3]], 8, [[1Co.3.18; 4.10|1Co.3:18 4:10]]; of things, παράδοσις, [[Mrk.7.13|Mrk.7:13]] (T, WH, txt., R, om.) : ζητήσεις, [[2Ti.2.23|2Ti.2:23]], [[Tit.3.9|Tit.3:9]]; τὸ μ. τ. θεοῦ, [[1Co.1.25|1Co.1:25]] τὰ μ. τ. κόσμου, [[1Co.1.27|1Co.1:27]]†
(AS)

G3403.def:
**μιμνήσκω**
(Bl., -ῄ-, § 3, 3), [in LXX chiefly for זָכַר ;]
**to remind**: mid, and pass.;
(a) **reflexive, to remind oneself of, hence, to remember**: with genitive of thing(s), [[Mat.26.75|Mat.26:75]], [[Luk.1.54, 72; 24.8|Luk.1:54, 72 24:8]], [[Act.11.16|Act.11:16]], [[2Pe.3.2|2Pe.3:2]], [[Jude.17|Ju 17]]; with neg., of sins, = to forgive, [[Heb.8.12; 10.17|Heb.8:12 10:17]]" (LXX) ; with genitive of person(s), [[Luk.23.42|Luk.23:42]] before ὅτι, [[Mat.5.23; 27.63|Mat.5:23 27:63]], [[Luk.16.25|Luk.16:25]], [[Jhn.2.17, 22; 12.16|Jhn.2:17, 22 12:16]]; ὡς, [[Luk.24.6|Luk.24:6]] pf., μέμνημι, in Pres. sense (cl.), with genitive of person(s) (of thing(s)), [[1Co.11.2|1Co.11:2]], [[2Ti.1.4|2Ti.1:4]]; pres., μιμνήσκομαι (only in late writers), with genitive of person(s), in sense of caring for, [[Heb.2.6|Heb.2:6]] (LXX) [[Heb.13.3|Heb.13:3]]
(b) in passive sense, to be remembered, aor., ἐμνήσθην : before ἐνώπιον, with genitive of person(s) (cf. [[Ezk.18.22|Eze.18:22]]), [[Act.10.31|Act.10:31]], [[Rev.16.19|Rev.16:19]] (cf. ἀνα-, ἐπ-ανα-, ὑπο- μιμνήσκω. The tenses of this verb are from the older μνάομαι).†
(AS)

G3431.def:
**μοιχεύω**
(μοιχός), [in LXX: [[Exo.20.13|Exo.20:13]], [[Lev.20.10|Lev.20:10]], al. (נָאַף) ;]
**to commit adultery**: absol., [[Mat.5.27; 19.18|Mat.5:27 19:18]], [[Mrk.10.19|Mrk.10:19]], [[Luk.16.18; 18.20|Luk.16:18 18:20]], [[Rom.2.22; 13.9|Rom.2:22 13:9]], [[Jas.2.11|Jas.2:11]]; with accusative fem., [[Mat.5.28|Mat.5:28]] Pass., of the woman, [[Mat.5.32; 19.9|Mat.5:32 19:9]] WH, mg.), [[Jhn.8.4|Jhn.8:4]] Metaphorical, of idolatry (see: μιοιχαλίς, and cf. [[Jer.3.9|Jer.3:9]], a1.), before μετ᾽ αὐτῆς, [[Rev.2.22|Rev.2:22]]†
(AS)

G3429.def:
**μοιχάω**, -ῶ
(= cl. μοιχεύω), [in LXX (mid., absol. and with accusative, with party of either sex as subj.) : [[Jer.3.8; 5.7; 7.9; 9.2; 23.14; 29.23|Jer.3:8 5:7 7:9 9:2 23:14 29:23]], [[Ezk.16.32; 23.37, 43|Eze.16:32 23:37, 43]] (נָאַף) * ;]
**to commit adultery with**: with accusative, fem. In NT always mid, in same sense; of the man : absol., [[Mat.5.32; 19.9|Mat.5:32 19:9]] (WH, txt., R, mg., om.); before ἐπ᾽ αὐτήν, [[Mrk.10.11|Mrk.10:11]] of the woman: [[Mrk.10.12|Mrk.10:12]]†
(AS)

G3483.def:
**ναί **
particle of affirmation,
**yea, verily, even so; in answer to a question**: [[Mat.9.28; 13.51; 17.25; 21.16|Mat.9:28 13:51 17:25 21:16]], [[Jhn.11.27; 21.15-16|Jhn.11:27 21:15-16]], [[Act.5.8; 22.27|Act.5:8 22:27]], [[Rom.3.29|Rom.3:29]]; before λέγω ὑμῖν, [[Mat.11.9|Mat.11:9]], [[Luk.7.26|Luk.7:26]]; repeated for emphasis, ναὶ ναί (opposite to oὒ oὔ): [[Mat.5.37|Mat.5:37]] ἤτω ὑμῶν τὸ ναὶ ναί, [[Jas.5.12|Jas.5:12]] ν. καὶ οὔ, [[2Co.1.18-19;|2Co.1:18-19]] ἵνα ᾖ . . . τὸ ναὶ ναί, [[2Co.1.17|2Co.1:17]] τὸ ν., [[2Co.1.20|2Co.1:20]] in assent to an assertion: [[Mat.15.27|Mat.15:27]], [[Mrk.7.28|Mrk.7:28]], [[Rev.14.13; 16.7|Rev.14:13 16:7]]; in confirmation of a previous assertion: [[Mat.11.26|Mat.11:26]], [[Luk.10.21; 11.51; 12.5|Luk.10:21 11:51 12:5]], [[Php.4.3|Php.4:3]], Phm 20; in solemn asseveration [[Rev.1.7; 22.20|Rev.1:7 22:20]].†
(AS)

G3400.def: **a Roman mile, milliarium **, = 1000 paces,= 8 stades, = 1680 yards, i. e. 80 yards less than our mile, (Polybius Historicus), etc. (ML)

G3498.def:
**νεκρός**, -α, -ον,
[in LXX chiefly for מֵת ;]
**dead**,
I. as _adj._,
1. prop.: [[Act.5.10; 20.9|Act.5:10 20:9]], [[Jas.2.26|Jas.2:26]], [[Rev.1.18|Rev.1:18]], al.; ὡσεὶ ν., [[Mat.28.4|Mat.28:4]], [[Mrk.9.26|Mrk.9:26]], [[Rev.1.17|Rev.1:17]]; of that which is subject to death, [[Rom.8.10|Rom.8:10]]
2. Metaphorical,
(a) **of persons**: [[Luk.15.24, 32|Luk.15:24, 32]]; of those immersed in worldly cares, [[Mat.8.22|Mat.8:22]], [[Luk.9.60|Luk.9:60]]; of spiritual death, [[Jhn.5.25|Jhn.5:25]], [[Rom.6.13|Rom.6:13]], [[Eph.5.14|Eph.5:14]], [[Rev.3.1|Rev.3:1]]; τ. παραπτώμασιν, [[Eph.2.1|Eph.2:1]], 5 [[Col.2.13|Col.2:13]]; of the opposite condition, ν. τῇ ἁμαρτίᾳ, [[Rom.6.11|Rom.6:11]]
(b) **of things regarded as inoperative, devoid of power**: ἁμαρτία, [[Rom.7.8|Rom.7:8]] πίστις, [[Jas.2.17, 26|Jas.2:17, 26]]; ἔργα, [[Heb.6.1; 9.14|Heb.6:1 9:14]].
II. As _subst._, νεκρός, ὁ (Hom., al.), chiefly in pl. (οἱ) ν., **the dead**: [[Mat.11.5|Mat.11:5]], [[Mrk.12.26|Mrk.12:26]], [[Luk.20.37|Luk.20:37]], [[1Co.15.15|1Co.15:15]], al.; ἀνάστασις (τ.) νεκρῶν, [[Mat.22.31|Mat.22:31]], [[Act.17.32|Act.17:32]], al.; ν. . . . ζῶντες, [[Mat.22.32|Mat.22:32]], [[Mrk.12.27|Mrk.12:27]], [[Act.10.42|Act.10:42]], al.; ἀπὸ νεκρῶν, [[Luk.16.30|Luk.16:30]] ἐκ ν., [[Mrk.6.14|Mrk.6:14]], [[Luk.24.46|Luk.24:46]], [[Jhn.12.1|Jhn.12:1]], [[Act.13.34|Act.13:34]], [[Rom.10.7|Rom.10:7]], al.; πρωτότοκος ἐκ τῶν ν., [[Col.1.18|Col.1:18]] ζωὴ ἐκ ν., [[Rom.11.15|Rom.11:15]] constr. praegn., ἐκ ν. ζῶντες, [[Rom.6.13|Rom.6:13]]
(AS)

G3419.def:
**μνημεῖον**, -ου, τό
[in LXX for קֶבֶר, קְבוּרָה ;]
1. a memorial, record (cl., cf. [[Wis.10.7|Wis.10:7]]).
2. (a) (cl.) a monument: [[Luk.11.47|Luk.11:47]]
(b) a sepulchre, tomb ([[Gen.23.6|Gen.23:6]], 9, [[Isa.22.16|Isa.22:16]], al.): [[Mat.23.29|Mat.23:29]], [[Mrk.5.2|Mrk.5:2]], [[Luk.11.44|Luk.11:44]], [[Jhn.5.28|Jhn.5:28]], and frequently in Gospels, [[Act.13.29|Act.13:29]]
_SYN._: μνῆμα (AS)

G3440.def:
**μόνον**, see: μόνος.
**μόνος**, -η, -ον,
[in LXX chiefly for לְבַד ;]
1. _adj._, **alone, solitary, forsaken**: with verb., [[Mat.14.23|Mat.14:23]], [[Mrk.6.47|Mrk.6:47]], [[Luk.9.36|Luk.9:36]], al.; with pron., [[Mat.18.15|Mat.18:15]], [[Mrk.9.2|Mrk.9:2]], al.; with subst., [[Mrk.9.8|Mrk.9:8]], [[Luk.4.8|Luk.4:8]], al.; pleonast., οὐκ . . . εἰ μὴ μ., [[Mat.12.4|Mat.12:4]], [[Luk.6.4|Luk.6:4]], al.; attrib., only, (ὁ) μ. θεός, [[Jhn.5.44; 17.3|Jhn.5:44 17:3]], [[Rom.16.27|Rom.16:27]], [[1Ti.1.17|1Ti.1:17]], [[Jude.25|Ju 25]].
2. As _adv_.,
(a) neut., (μόνον, **alone, only**: referring to verb or predic., [[Mat.9.21|Mat.9:21]], [[Mrk.5.36|Mrk.5:36]], [[Jas.1.22|Jas.1:22]], al. (see Bl., §44, 2); οὐ (μὴ) μ., [[Gal.4.18|Gal.4:18]], [[Jas.1.22|Jas.1:22]]; οὐ μ. . . . ἀλλά (Bl, §77, 13.3), [[Act.19.26|Act.19:26]], [[1Jn.5.6|1Jn.5:6]], al.; id. before καί (Bl., §81, 1.2), [[Rom.5.3; 9.10|Rom.5:3 9:10]], [[2Co.8.19|2Co.8:19]], al.;
(b) κατὰ μόνας, **alone** (Bl., §44, 1), [[Mrk.4.10|Mrk.4:10]], [[Luk.9.18|Luk.9:18]].
(AS)

G3428.def:
1. **an adulteress **, (New Testament):as _adjective_ **adulterous **, (New Testament)
2. as _Substantive_ = μοιχεία, (New Testament) (ML)

G3466.def:
**μυστήρισν**, -ου, τό
(μυέω), [in LXX: Dan LXX TH [[Dan.2.18|Dan.2:18]] ff. (רָז), [[Tob.12.7, 11|Tob.12:7, 11]], [[Jdt.2.2|Jdth.2:2]], [[Wis.2.22; 6.22; 14.15, 23|Wis.2:22 6:22 14:15, 23]], [[Sir.3.18; 22.22; 27.16-17, 21|Sir.3:18 22:22 27:16-17, 21]], [[2Ma.13.21|2Ma.13:21]] * ;]
1. that which is known to the μύστης (initiated), a mystery or secret doctrine, mostly in pl., τὰ μ. (Æsch., Hdt., al.).
2. In later writers (Menand., Incert., 168), that which may not be revealed (not, however, as in the modern sense, intrinsically difficult to understand), a secret or mystery of any kind (To, Jth, 2Mac, ll, with).
3. In NT, of the counsels of God (cf. _Th._: [[Job.15.8|Job.15:8]], [[Psa.25.14|Psa.25:14]] for סוֹד), once hidden but now revealed in the Gospel or some fact thereof;
(a) **of the Christian revelation generally **: [[Rom.16.25|Rom.16:25]], [[1Co.2.7|1Co.2:7]], [[Col.1.26-27|Col.1:26-27]], [[Eph.3.3|Eph.3:3]], 9; τ. βασιλείας τ. θεοῦ, [[Mrk.4.11|Mrk.4:11]] τ. θεοῦ, [[1Co.2.1|1Co.2:1]], [[Rev.10.7|Rev.10:7]]; τ. θ., Χριστοῦ, [[Col.2.2|Col.2:2]] τ. Χριστοῦ., [[Col.4.3|Col.4:3]], [[Eph.3.4|Eph.3:4]]; τ. θελήματος αὐτοῦ, [[Eph.1.9|Eph.1:9]] τ. εὐαγγελίον, [[Eph.6.19|Eph.6:19]] τ. πίστεως, [[1Ti.3.9|1Ti.3:9]] τ. εὐσεβείας, [[1Ti.3.16|1Ti.3:16]]
(b) **of particular truths, or details, of the Christian revelation **: [[Rom.11.25|Rom.11:25]], [[1Co.15.51|1Co.15:51]], [[Eph.5.32|Eph.5:32]], [[2Th.2.7|2Th.2:7]], [[Rev.1.20; 17.5, 7|Rev.1:20 17:5, 7]]; pl., τὰ μ., [[1Co.13.2; 14.2|1Co.13:2 14:2]]; θεοῦ, [[1Co.4.1|1Co.4:1]] τ. βασιλείας τ. οὐρανῶν (θεοῦ), [[Mat.13.11|Mat.13:11]], [[Luk.8.10|Luk.8:10]] (cf. Westc., _Eph._, 180 ff.; AR, _Eph._, 234 ff.; Lft., Col., 165 f.; Hatch, _Essays_, 57 f.; _DB_, iii, 465 ff.; _DCG_, ii, 213 ff.).†
(AS)

G3421.def:
**μνημονεύω**
(μνήμων, mindful) [in LXX for זָכַר ;]
1. **to call to mind, remember **: absol., [[Mrk.8.18|Mrk.8:18]] with genitive of person(s), [[Luk.17.32|Luk.17:32]], [[Col.4.18|Col.4:18]], [[1Th.1.3|1Th.1:3]], [[Heb.11.15|Heb.11:15]] (but see infr.) [[Heb.13.7|Heb.13:7]] τ. πτωχῶν, [[Gal.2.20|Gal.2:20]] with genitive of thing(s), [[Jhn.15.20; 16.4, 21|Jhn.15:20 16:4, 21]], [[Act.20.35|Act.20:35]]; with accusative obj. (as more frequently in cl.), of persons, [[2Ti.2.8|2Ti.2:8]] of things, [[Mat.16.9|Mat.16:9]], [[1Th.2.9|1Th.2:9]], [[Rev.18.5|Rev.18:5]]; before ὅτι, [[Act.20.31|Act.20:31]], [[Eph.2.11|Eph.2:11]], [[2Th.2.5|2Th.2:5]]; πόθεν, [[Rev.2.5|Rev.2:5]] πῶς, [[Rev.3.3|Rev.3:3]]
2. **to make mention of**: with genitive, [[Heb.11.15|Heb.11:15]] (but see supr., and cf. M, _Th._, I, 18); before περί, [[Heb.11.22|Heb.11:22]]†
(AS)

G3458.def:
**μύλος**, -ου, ὁ
[in LXX for רֵחֶה, [[Num.11.8|Num.11:8]], [[Deu.24.6|Deu.24:6]], al. ;]
1. = μύλη, a mill (Strab., Plut., LXX) : [[Mat.24.41|Mat.24:41]], [[Rev.18.22|Rev.18:22]].
2. a mill-stone (Anth.) : [[Rev.18.21|Rev.18:21]] (T); μ. ὀνικός, [[Mat.18.6|Mat.18:6]], [[Mrk.9.42|Mrk.9:42]] (see Swete, in l).†
(AS)

G3442.def:
**μον-όφθαλμος**, -ον
(μόνος),
Ionic and κοινή,
**one-eyed, having one eye**: [[Mat.18.9|Mat.18:9]], [[Mrk.9.47|Mrk.9:47]].†
(AS)

G3463.def:
**μυρίος**, -α, -ον
1. **numberless, countless, infinite**: [[1Co.4.15; 14.19|1Co.4:15 14:19]].
2. As a definite numeral, in pl., μύριοι, -αι, -α, **ten thousand**: [[Mat.18.24|Mat.18:24]]†
(AS)

G3495.def:
**νεανίσκος**, -ου, ὁ
(dimin. of νεανίας) [in LXX chiefly for נַעַר, also for בָּחוּר, etc. ;]
**a young man, youth**: [[Mat.19.20, 22|Mat.19:20, 22]], [[Mrk.14.51; 16.5|Mrk.14:51 16:5]], [[Luk.7.14|Luk.7:14]], [[Act.2.17|Act.2:17]]" (LXX) [[Act.23.18, 22|Act.23:18, 22]], [[1Jn.2.13-14|1Jn.2:13-14]]; of an attendant (cf. [[Gen.14.24|Gen.14:24]], al.) : [[Act.5.10|Act.5:10]].†
(AS)

G3409.def:
**μισθόω**, -ῶ
(μισθός) [in LXX (mid.) chiefly for שָׂכָר ;]
to let out for hire. Mid., **to hire**: with accusative, [[Mat.20.1|Mat.20:1]], 7.†
(AS)

G3485.def:
**ναός**, -οῦ, ὁ
(Att.. νεώς; ναίω, to inhabit), [in LXX (νεώς, [[2Ma.6.2|2Ma.6:2]], al.) chiefly for הֵיכָל ;]
1. a temple (Hom., Find., al.).
2. **The inmost part of a temple, the shrine **(Hat., Xen., al.); in NT,
(a) **generally**: pl., [[Act.17.24|Act.17:24]] of silver models of a heathen shrine, [[Act.19.24|Act.19:24]]
(b) of the temple building proper, or sanctuary, at Jerusalem, as distinct from τ. ἱερόν (which see), **the whole temple enclosure**: [[Mat.23.16-17, 35; 27.5, 40|Mat.23:16-17, 35 27:5, 40]], [[Mrk.14.58; 15.29|Mrk.14:58 15:29]] [[Jhn.2.19-20|Jhn.2:19-20]], [[Rev.11.2|Rev.11:2]]; (τοῦ) θεοῦ, [[Mat.26.61; 27.51|Mat.26:61 27:51]], [[Mrk.15.38|Mrk.15:38]], [[Luk.1.9, 21-22; 23.45|Luk.1:9, 21-22 23:45]], [[1Co.3.17|1Co.3:17]], [[2Co.6.16|2Co.6:16]], [[2Th.2.4|2Th.2:4]], [[Rev.11.1|Rev.11:1]]; of the temple in the Apocal. visions, [[Rev.3.12; 7.15; 11.19; 14.15, 17; 15.5-6, 8; 16.1, 17; 21.22|Rev.3:12 7:15 11:19 14:15, 17 15:5-6, 8 16:1, 17 21:22]] a. Metaphorical, of Christians, [[1Co.3.16; 6.19|1Co.3:16 6:19]], [[2Co.6.16|2Co.6:16]], [[Eph.2.21|Eph.2:21]]; of Christ's body, [[Jhn.2.21|Jhn.2:21]] (cf. [[Jhn.2.19|Jhn.2:19]]); ὁ θεὸς ν. αὐτῆς ἐστιν, [[Rev.21.22|Rev.21:22]] b.†
_SYN._: ἱερόν (AS)

G3422.def:
**μνημόσυνον**, -ου, τό
(μνήμων, mindful), [in LXX frequently for זֵכֶר, זִכְרוֹן and cogn. forms ;]
**a memorial**: [[Mat.26.13|Mat.26:13]], [[Mrk.14.9|Mrk.14:9]], [[Act.10.4|Act.10:4]] (where cf. [[Lev.2.9, 16; 5.12|Lev.2:9, 16 5:12]], Num_5:28, [[Sir.45.16|Sir.45:16]], al.).†
(AS)

G3411.def:
**μισθωτός**, -ή, όν
(μισθόω), [in LXX for שָׂכִיר, [[Exo.12.45|Exo.12:45]], al. ;]
**hired**; as subst., ὁ μ., **a hired servant, hireling**: [[Mrk.1.20|Mrk.1:20]], [[Jhn.10.12-13|Jhn.10:12-13]].†
(AS)

G3418.def:
**μνῆμα**, -τος, τό
(μνάομαι), [in LXX for קֶבֶר, קְבוּרָה ;]
1. a memorial.
2. **a sepulchral monument, a sepulchre, tomb**: [[Mrk.5.3, 5; 15.46; 16.2|Mrk.5:3, 5 15:46 16:2]] (WH, μνημεῖον), [[Luk.8.27; 23.53; 24.1|Luk.8:27 23:53 24:1]], [[Act.2.29; 7.16|Act.2:29 7:16]], [[Rev.11.9|Rev.11:9]].†
_SYN._: μνημεῖον (AS)

G3424.def:
**μογι-λάλος**, -ον
(μόγις, λάλος), [in LXX: [[Isa.35.6|Isa.35:6]] (אִלֵּם) * ;]
**speaking with difficulty**: [[Mrk.7.32|Mrk.7:32]] (Tr., txt., μογγιλάλος, thick-voiced, see Swete, in l).†
(AS)

G3462.def:
**μυρίζω**
(μύρον),
Ionic and poët. (comic),
**to anoint**: [[Mrk.14.8|Mrk.14:8]]†
_SYN._: see: ἀλείφω, and cf. μύρον (AS)

G3484.def:
**Ναίν** (Rec. Ναΐν), ἡ, indecl. (Heb. נָאָה),
**Nain, a village of Galilee**: [[Luk.7.11|Luk.7:11]]†
(AS)

G3425.def:
**μόγις**
_ adv._ (μόγος, toil), [in LXX: [[Wis.9.16|Wis.9:16]] א A (μόγις, B), [[3Ma.7.6|3Ma.7:6]] * ;]
**with toil or difficulty, hardly**: [[Luk.9.39|Luk.9:39]] (μόγις, WH).†
(AS)

G3461.def:
**μυριάς**, -άδος, ἡ
(μυρίος), [in LXX chiefly for רְבָבָה ;]
**ten thousand, a myriad**: pl., [[Act.19.19|Act.19:19]], [[Rev.5.11; 9.16|Rev.5:11 9:16]]; hyperb., of vast numbers, [[Luk.12.1|Luk.12:1]], [[Act.21.20|Act.21:20]], [[Heb.12.12|Heb.12:12]], [[Jude.14|Ju 14]].†
(AS)

G3448.def:
**μόσχος**, -ου, ὁ
[in LXX chiefly for פַּר, also for שׁוֹר, עֵגֶל. etc. ;]
1. a young shoot or twig.
2. ὁ, ἡ, μ., offspring;
(a) **of men**;
(b) **of animals**; most frequently (as always in LXX), **a calf, bullock, heifer**: [[Luk.15.23, 27; 15.30|Luk.15:23, 27 15:30]], [[Heb.9.12, 19|Heb.9:12, 19]] [[Rev.4.7|Rev.4:7]].†
(AS)

G3457.def:
**μυλικός**, -ή, -όν
(μύλη, a mill),
**of a mill**: λίθος μ., [[Luk.17.2|Luk.17:2]]†
(AS)

G3414.def:
**μνᾶ**, -ᾶς, ἡ
(a Semitic word; cf. _Heb._ מָנֶה, Aram. מְנֵא, a weight and a sum of money = 100 shekels, cf. [[1Ki.10.17|3Ki.10:17]]),
a mina (Let.), mna, in Attic a weight and sum of money = 100 δραχμαί (which see) : [[Luk.19.13, 16; 19.18, 20; 19.24-25|Luk.19:13, 16 19:18, 20 19:24-25]].†
(AS)

G3482.def:
**Ναθαναήλ**, ὁ indecl. (Heb. נְתַנְאֵל),
Nathaniel, prob. to be identified with Bartholomew (which see): [[Jhn.1.45-49; 21.2|Jhn.1:45-49 21:2]].†
(AS)

G3447.def:
**μοσχο-ποιέω**, -ῶ
to make a calf (as an image) : [[Act.7.41|Act.7:41]] (LXX, ἐποίησε μόσχον).†
(AS)

G3434.def:
**Μολόχ**, ὁ indecl. (Heb. מֶלֶךְ, prop. מֶלֶךְ King, but vocalized to read בֺּשֶׁת, shame, of. Βάαλ, and see _DB_, iii, 415 f.),
**Moloch, the god of the Ammonites **: [[Act.7.43|Act.7:43]] (LXX).†
(AS)

G3494.def:
**νεανίας**, -ου, ὁ
(νεάν = νέος) [in LXX for נַעַר, בָּחוּר ;]
**a young man**: [[Act.7.58; 20.9; 23.17-18|Act.7:58 20:9 23:17-18]].†
(AS)

G3433.def:
**μόλις **
_adv._ (μόλος, toil)
post-Hom. alternative for μόγις,
[in LXX: [[Pro.11.31|Pro.11:31]], [[Wis.9.16|Wis.9:16]], al. ;]
**with difficulty, hardly, scarcely**: [[Luk.9.39|Luk.9:39]] (T, μόγις), [[Act.14.8; 27.7-8, 16|Act.14:8 27:7-8, 16]], [[Rom.5.7|Rom.5:7]], [[1Pe.4.18|1Pe.4:18]]" (LXX) .†
(AS)

G3465.def:
**Μυσία**, -ας, ἡ
**Mysia, a province of Asia Minor**: [[Act.16.7-8|Act.16:7-8]]†
(AS)

G3412.def:
**Μιτυλήνη**, -ης, ἡ
(late form - Strab., Plut. - of cl. Μυτιλ-),
**Mytilene, Mitylene, chief city of Lesbos**: [[Act.20.14|Act.20:14]]†
(AS)

G3460.def:
**Μύρα**, Μύρρα (LT, Tr., WH), -ων, τά,
**Myra, a city of Lycia **: [[Act.27.5|Act.27:5]]†
(AS)

G3491.def:
**ναῦς**, νεώς accusative ναῦν, ἡ,
[in LXX for עָנִי, אֲנִיָּה ;]
**a ship**: [[Act.27.41|Act.27:41]] (elsewhere in NT always τ. πλοῖον; see M, [[Pro.25.1-28|Pro.25:1-28]] f.; Bl., Gosp., 186 f.).†
(AS)

G3410.def:
**μίσθωμα**, -τος, τό
(μισθόω), [in LXX: [[Deu.23.18|Deu.23:18]] (19), [[Mic.1.7|Mic.1:7]], [[Ezk.16.31, 34; 16.41|Eze.16:31, 34 16:41]] (אֶתְנַן), [[Ezk.16.33|Eze.16:33]], (נֵדֶה, נָדָן), [[Ezk.16.32|Eze.16:32]], [[Pro.19.13|Pro.19:13]] * ;]
1. price, hire (cl, and LXX).
2. **In sense not found elsewhere, a hired dwelling**: [[Act.28.30|Act.28:30]]†
(AS)

G3417.def:
**μνεία**, -ας, ἡ
(μιμνήσκω), [in LXX for זָכַר, its parts and deriva­tives ;]
remembrance, mention (= μνήμη) : [[Php.1.3|Php.1:3]] μ. ποιεῖσθαι, with genitive of person(s), [[Rom.1.9|Rom.1:9]], [[Eph.1.16|Eph.1:16]], [[1Th.1.2|1Th.1:2]], Phm 4 (cf. [[Psa.111.4|Psa.111:4]]); μ. ἔχειν, with genitive of person(s), [[1Th.3.6|1Th.3:6]], [[2Ti.1.3|2Ti.1:3]] (on the seel. in [[Rom.12.13|Rom.12:13]], see _ICC_, in I.; Field, _Notes_, 163).†
(AS)

G3446.def:
**μόρφωσις**, -εως, ἡ
(μορφόω),
1. a forming, shaping (Theophr.).
2. **form, outline, semblance**: [[Rom.2.20|Rom.2:20]] opposite to δύναμις, [[2Ti.3.5|2Ti.3:5]]†
_SYN._: μορφή (which see), σχῆμα (AS)

G3499.def:
**νεκρόω**, ῶ
(νεκρός),
**to make dead, put to death**; pass., **to be dead**: hyperbolically, of impotent age, [[Heb.11.12|Heb.11:12]] σῶμα, [[Rom.4.19|Rom.4:19]] Trop., of carnal impulses, τὰ μέλη, [[Col.3.5|Col.3:5]]†
(AS)

G3488.def:
**the narcissus **, (Homeric Hymns), etc.
From ναρκάω, because of its narcotic properties. (ML)

G3402.def:
**μιμητής**, -οῦ, ὁ
(μιμέομαι),
in NT always (like the verb) in good sense, **an imitator**: [[1Co.4.16; 11.1|1Co.4:16 11:1]], [[Eph.5.1|Eph.5:1]], [[1Th.1.6; 2.14|1Th.1:6 2:14]], [[Heb.6.12|Heb.6:12]].†
(AS)

G3435.def:
**μολύνω **
[in LXX: [[Gen.37.31|Gen.37:31]] (טָבַל), [[Isa.59.3|Isa.59:3]] (גָּאַל ni.), [[Zec.14.2|Zec.14:2]] (שָׁכַב ni.), [[Sir.21.28|Sir.21:28]], al. ;]
**to stain, soil, defile**; in NT always symb. and figuratively: [[1Co.8.7|1Co.8:7]], [[Rev.3.4; 14.4|Rev.3:4 14:4]].†
_SYN._: μιαίνω, q.v (AS)

G3469.def:
**μωμάομαι**, -ῶμαι
(μῶμος),
poët. and late prose,
[in LXX: [[Pro.9.7|Pro.9:7]] (מאוּם), [[Wis.10.14|Wis.10:14]], [[Sir.31.18|Sir.31:18]] * ;]
**to find fault with, blame**: [[2Co.8.20|2Co.8:20]] pass., [[2Co.6.3|2Co.6:3]]†
(AS)

G3436.def:
**μολυσμός**, -οῦ, ὁ
(μολύνω), [in LXX: [[Jer.23.15|Jer.23:15]] (חֲנֻפָה), I [[Est.8.83|Est.8:83]], [[2Ma.5.27|2Ma.5:27]] * ;]
**defilement**: with genitive obj., [[2Co.7.1|2Co.7:1]] (Plut., FlJ).†
(AS)

G3489.def:
**ναυαγέω**, -ῶ
(ναῦς, + ἄγνυμι, to break)
**to suffer shipwreck**: [[2Co.11.25|2Co.11:25]] metaphorically, before περὶ τ. πίστιν, [[1Ti.1.19|1Ti.1:19]]†
(AS)

G3449.def:
**μόχθος**, -ου, ὁ
(= Hom. μόγος), in cl. chiefly poët., [in LXX for תְּלָאָה, עָמָל, etc. ;]
**toil, labour, hardship, distress**: [[2Co.11.27|2Co.11:27]], [[1Th.2.9|1Th.2:9]], [[2Th.3.8|2Th.3:8]].†
_SYN._: κόπος (which see), πόνος (AS)

G3456.def:
**μυκτηρίζω**
(μυκτήρ, the nose), [in LXX: [[4Ki.19.21|4Ki.19:21]], [[Job.22.19|Job.22:19]], [[Psa.80.6|Psa.80:6]], al. (לָעַג), [[Pro.1.30|Pro.1:30]] (נָאַץ) [[Pro.15.20|Pro.15:20]] (בָּזָה), [[1Ma.7.34|1Ma.7:34]], al. ;]
**to turn up the nose or sneer at, mock**: pass., [[Gal.6.7|Gal.6:7]] (cf. ἐκ-μυκτηρίζω).†
(AS)

G3444.def:
**μορφή**, -ῆς, ἡ
[in LXX: [[Jdg.8.18|Jdg.8:18]] A (תֹּאַר), [[Job.4.16|Job.4:16]] (תְּמוּנָה), [[Isa.44.13|Isa.44:13]] (תַּבְנִית), Dan LXX 3:19 (צֶלֶם), Da TH [[Dan.4.33; 5.6, 9-10; 7.28|Dan.4:33 5:6, 9-10 7:28]] (זִיו), [[Tob.1.13|Tob.1:13]], [[Wis.18.1|Wis.18:1]], [[4Ma.15.4|4Ma.15:4]] * ;]
**form, shape, appearance **(Hom., Eur., . sch., al.); in philos. lang. the specific character or essential form (Arist., see Gifford, Inc., 26 ff.) : [[Mrk.16.12|Mrk.16:12]], [[Php.2.6-7|Php.2:6-7]].†
_SYN._: μόρφωσις, the outline, delineation, semblance of the μορφή, as distinct from the μ. itself (Lft., _Notes_, 262); σχῆμα, shape, fashion, disting. from μορφή as the outward and accidental from the inward and essential (cf. Tr., _Syn._, § LXX; Lft., Phi., 125 ff.; Gifford., Inc., l.with) (AS)

G3453.def:
**μυέω**, -ῶ
(μύω, to shut the mouth), [in LXX: [[3Ma.2.30|3Ma.2:30]] * ;]
**to initiate into the mysteries **(so chiefly in cl.; LXX, l.with); hence, **to instruct**: pass., [[Php.4.12|Php.4:12]] (RV, I have learned the secret).†
(AS)

G3437.def:
**μομφή**, ῆς, ἡ
(μέμφομαι),
poët. form of μέμψις,
**blame, com­plaint**: [[Col.3.13|Col.3:13]]†
(AS)

G3454.def:
**μῦθος**, -ου, ὁ
[in LXX: [[Wis.17.4|Wis.17:4]] A, [[Sir.20.19|Sir.20:19]] * ;]
1. speech, con­versation.
2. (a) a story, narrative (Hom.);
(b) later, opposite to λόγος (a true narrative) = Lat. fabula, **a myth, fable, fiction**: [[1Ti.1.4; 4.7|1Ti.1:4 4:7]], [[2Ti.4.4|2Ti.4:4]], [[Tit.1.14|Tit.1:14]], [[2Pe.1.16|2Pe.1:16]].†
_SYN._. λόγος, q.v (AS)

G3443.def:
**μονόω**, -ῶ
(μόνος), [in Aq.: [[Gen.49.6|Gen.49:6]] ;]
**to leave alone, forsake**: of a childless widow, pf. ptcp. pass., [[1Ti.5.5|1Ti.5:5]]†
(AS)

G3405.def:
**μισθαποδοσία**, -ας, ἡ
(μισθός, ἀποδίδωμι; cl. μισθοδοσία),
**pay­ment of wages, recompense**; meton.,
(a) **of reward**: [[Heb.10.35; 11.26|Heb.10:35 11:26]];
(b) **of punishment **: [[Heb.2.2|Heb.2:2]]†
(AS)

G3406.def:
**μισθ-απο-δότης**, -ου, ὁ
(see supr.),
**one who pays wages**; meton., **a rewarder**: [[Heb.11.6|Heb.11:6]]†
(AS)

G3468.def:
**μώλωψ**, -ωπος, ὁ
[in LXX for חַבּוּרָה, [[Exo.21.25|Exo.21:25]], al. ;]
**a bruise, wound from a stripe**: [[1Pe.2.24|1Pe.2:24]] (LXX) (Arist., Plut., al.).†
(AS)

G3467.def:
**μυ-ωπάζω**
(μύωψ, closing the eyes, short-sighted; μύω, ὤψ)
**to be short-sighted**: [[2Pe.1.9|2Pe.1:9]] (R, mg., closing his eyes; see _ICC_, in l).†
(AS)

G3420.def:
**μνήμη**, -ης, ἡ
(μνάομαι), [in LXX for זֵכֶר, זִכְרוֹן ;]
**memory, remembrance, mention**: μ. ποιεῖσθαι, with genitive, to remember, [[2Pe.1.15|2Pe.1:15]] (but in cl., π., μ. π. more frequently = to make mention, and so perh. here, cf. Mayor, in l; and for ex. from π., see Zorell, see word).†
_SYN._: μνεία, q.v (AS)

G3470.def:
**μῶμος**, -ου, ὁ
[in LXX, of physical blemishes : [[Lev.21.17|Lev.21:17]] ff., [[Deu.15.21|Deu.15:21]], [[Sng.4.7|Sng.4:7]], al. (מאוּם); of mental defect, [[Sir.20.24|Sir.20:24]], al. ;]
1. in cl. poets and late prose, blame, disgrace.
2. In LXX, perb. because of resemblance to a physical blemish (cf. ἄμωμος, [[1Pe.1.19|1Pe.1:19]], and see Hort., in l); metaphorically, of licentious persons, [[2Pe.2.13|2Pe.2:13]]†
(AS)

G3413.def:
**Μιχαήλ**, ὁ indecl. (Heb. מִיכָאֵל, who like God?),
Michael, the Archangel (cf. [[Dan.12.1|Dan.12:1]]) : [[Jude.9|Ju 9]], [[Rev.12.7|Rev.12:7]].†
(AS)

G3455.def:
**μυκάσμαι**, -ῶμαι in cl. chiefly poët.,
[in Sm.: [[Job.6.5|Job.6:5]] * ;]
prop., of oxen (onomatop.), to low, bellow; of a lion, **to roar**: [[Rev.10.3|Rev.10:3]]†
(AS)

G3451.def:
**μουσικός**, -ή, -όν
[in LXX: [[Gen.31.27|Gen.31:27]], [[Ezk.26.13|Eze.26:13]] (שִׁיר), Dan LXX TH [[Dan.3.5|Dan.3:5]] ff. (זְמָר), [[Sir.22.6|Sir.22:6]], al. ;]
skilled in the arts, esp. in music; as subst., ὁ μ., **a minstrel, musician**: [[Rev.18.22|Rev.18:22]]†
(AS)
